conviction_note: The period is half pre-released: Orion raised its FY2026 guide on 20 Oct (EBIT 730-790m from 650-750m) on royalty income, so the Q3 detail is the only new line and a second guide change a week later is unlikely. That points to a smaller move, but this name's own results days run about 5-6% (median of the last 10, B share, including +5.2% and -9.9% on prints whose guide was already out), so abs_move is 5.0. p_up 46 is a mild negative lean from a proxy: the stock is up 17% in 20 sessions to 96, against a mean target of 78.6 on Orion's own Vara consensus page, and on this name's last 10 prints the three with a 20-day run-up above 5.7% fell 5-11%. The headline beat against the stale published consensus is already public and offsets part of that. The findings sum (-1.0) and the scaled number (-0.4) agree in sign. The scaled number is smaller because p_up is close to 50.

already_public.what: Inside information: FY2026 outlook upgraded on royalty income growing faster than expected over the first nine months. Net sales EUR 2,070-2,140m (was 2,000-2,100m), operating profit EUR 730-790m (was 650-750m). No preliminary Q3 figures were given.
DASL-HiCaP Phase 3 interim: darolutamide (Nubeqa) cut the risk of metastasis or death by 58% (HR 0.42) in high-risk localised prostate cancer (ESMO LBA). The stock rose 4.4% on 26 Oct.
Jefferies upgraded to Buy, target EUR 115 (was 77), on a 60% probability that US Nubeqa exclusivity runs past 2033. Seen only as a forum repost of an investing.com item.
Inderes Q3 preview: estimates nudged up after the upgrade, rating cut to Reduce, target EUR 87 (was 83). FY26e EBIT 742.1m against a guide midpoint of 760m.
Changes in the Group Executive Team from 1 January 2027

new_in_release.expect: Q3 EBIT is probably above the stale Vara consensus of 198.9m (median 203). The 20 Oct guide implies H2 EBIT of 439-499m against roughly 433m in that consensus, and management already knew Q3 when it raised. Against the real post-upgrade bar (about 210-220m, inferred) the result is roughly in line. Sign unknown.
Most likely reiterated at 730-790m a week after the upgrade. A narrowing from the low end is possible, given Orion's habit of conservative guides. Mildly positive if it comes, otherwise neutral.

The split between Nubeqa royalties and product deliveries for Q3, the first read on Q3 Nubeqa demand before Bayer reports in November. Also any comment on 2027 (US Xtandi generics, IRA selection). Sign unknown.
unknown; H1 operating cash flow per share was EUR 2.21 (1.12), so this has not been a weak line

session_check: bmo. Orion publishes the January-September 2026 interim report on Wednesday 28 Oct at about 12:00 EET (10:00 UTC), INSIDE the Helsinki session, and the webcast is at 14:00 EET. So the close(27 Oct) to close(28 Oct) window contains the release and its whole same-day reaction; it is not a pre-open release. Source: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bb9df8e671cfbc4923c826a014e34e4dd&lang=en&src=listed (14 Oct), repeated in the 20 Oct inside-information release.

findings.finding: The 20 Oct upgrade puts FY EBIT guidance at 730-790m, while Orion's own published Vara consensus (dated 23 Oct, built from pre-upgrade estimates) has FY 724.6m and Q3 EBIT 198.9m. The headline comparison on the day will therefore read as a beat against the published consensus, but the number behind it is public.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints after a pre-announced upgrade: H1 2025 (upgrade 9 Jul, print 18 Jul) +5.2%; FY2024 (upgrade 15 Jan 2025, print 25 Feb) +7.5%. FY2025 (milestone and guide 3 Dec, 2026 guide 14 Jan, print 12 Feb 2026) -9.9%. The upgrade itself on 21 Oct 2026 drew only +1.8%. Mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The upgrade was public on 20 Oct and Inderes revised to 742m on 23 Oct. Only the wire headline 'beat versus consensus' is still to come, because the published consensus has not caught up. If the market treated the stale consensus as the bar, the 21 Oct reaction would have been larger than +1.8%.
findings.independence: Inderes 21 Oct: 'Uuden ohjeistushaarukan keskikohta ... liikevoitto-ohjeistus viittaa todennäköisesti ennustettamme jonkin verran parempaan loppuvuoteen' (the midpoint of the new range implies a somewhat better rest of the year than we forecast), https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/orion-nostaa-ohjeistustaan-vahvan-rojaltivirran-siivittamana

findings.finding: The stock goes into the print at an all-time high: +17.5% in 20 sessions and +9% in 5, at 96 against a mean target of 78.6 (high 88) on Orion's consensus page. Inderes cut to Reduce on 23 Oct ('Kurssi hinnoittelee jo paljon tulevaa potentiaalia'). On this name's last 10 report days, the three with a 20-day run-up above 5.7% fell 10.6%, 9.9% and 5.3%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 20-day run-up before prints and the B-share reaction: Oct 2025 +5.8 -> -10.6; Feb 2026 +6.1 -> -9.9; Apr 2026 +7.2 -> -5.3; Aug 2024 +5.6 -> +2.1. Five of the six prints with a run-up below 5% rose. The current run-up of 17% is the largest in the sample.
findings.original_quote: Laskemme suosituksen Vähennä-tasolle (aik. Lisää.), sillä kesän ja kevään kurssiralli on heikentänyt tuotto-riskisuhdetta. [We cut the rating to Reduce (was Accumulate), as the spring and summer rally has weakened the risk-reward.] Inderes, 23.10.2026, via https://forum.inderes.com/t/557.json
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: this is the run-up, which is the baseline's own lean (-0.87). What it adds is name-specific: Orion's stretched prints have sold off, and the targets of 7 sell-side houses sit 9-40 points below spot. If that were priced, the stock would not have added 4.4% on 26 Oct on a pipeline readout that Inderes says changes no forecast. It is a proxy built on n=10.
findings.independence: Inderes 26 Oct: 'Pidämme ennusteemme toistaiseksi ennallaan' (forecasts unchanged after DASL-HiCaP), https://www.inderes.fi/analyst-comments/orion-myonteisia-valituloksia-nubeqan-tehosta-uudessa-kayttoaiheessa

findings.finding: Q2 profit included one-off tablet-delivery timing (Inderes), and under Orion's own disclosed mechanism each quarter's product deliveries are deducted in full from the next quarter's royalty payment. So the high Q2 deliveries are a headwind for the Q3 royalty line. The Q3 2025 print, which followed record deliveries, fell 10.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (28 Oct 2025) -10.6% on the B share; the cause was not confirmed in a document.
findings.original_quote: Neljänneksen kasvussa oli kuitenkin jossain määrin kertaluonteisuutta lääketablettien toimitusmäärien jaksottumisesta ja muista tekijöistä johtuen. [The quarter's growth had some one-off element from the timing of tablet delivery volumes and other factors.] Inderes 20.07.2026, https://www.inderes.fi/research/orion-q226-huipputuloksessa-mukana-kertaluonteista-myotatuulta
findings.why_not_priced: Weak. Analysts model the deduction mechanism, and Orion said on 20 Oct that royalties over nine months grew faster than expected, which argues against a Q3 royalty shortfall. What remains is a possibly soft Q3 within a strong nine months, with the raised guide loaded on Q4. Sized near 0 for that reason.

IRA selection of Nubeqa for US price negotiation, expected to be settled by February 2027 per Inderes; a price cut could affect 10-20% of global Nubeqa sales from 2029.

baseline_tension: What I found agrees with the lean and the run-up (a mildly negative, stretched-into-print read). The only thing cutting against it is the headline beat against the stale published consensus, and that number is already public.
language_note: Inderes's Finnish notes (21, 23 and 26 Oct) carried the post-upgrade FY26e EBIT of 742.1m, the cut to Vähennä with target 87, and the Q2 'kertaluonteista myötätuulta' (one-off tablet-delivery timing) point. The English feed and English search did not surface these.
The Finnish Inderes forum carried the Jefferies upgrade (Buy, EUR 115, Nubeqa exclusivity thesis) and the 19 Oct dividend ex-date before any English search returned them.
The primary filings (upgrade, report-time notice, H1 report, DASL-HiCaP) were bilingual on the Nasdaq Nordic feed and added nothing in Finnish beyond the English text.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the stale-consensus beat finding went from +0.5 to +0.2, because the upgrade behind it is public.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the run-up finding agrees with priced_lean, so it went from -1.5 to -1.0 and p_up moved from 45 to 46.
'The hunter's own caveat has to reach the number': the delivery-deduction finding, which the 20 Oct royalty statement argues against, went from -0.3 to -0.2.

Pre-released period with the guide unlikely to move again: abs_move went from 5.5 to 5.0, but not down to the 3% base, because this name's own pre-released prints moved 5-10% and the file says history moves p_up, not abs_move.
